name: services/facperms/fpclasses
description: Get information on multiple faculty permission classes.
brief_description: Get information on multiple permission classes.

arguments.name: fpclass_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of faculty permission class IDs.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of fpclass method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary: your fpclass_ids will be mapped to dictionary's keys, and each value will contain the description of one permission class, as defined in the fpclass method.
